design_description: A dark charcoal and black jersey built around a wild tropical street-art aesthetic. The base uses a subtle tone-on-tone palm and foliage pattern, dark enough to read as a plain charcoal shirt from distance while revealing the leaf detail up close. Over that sit energetic paint splashes and streaks in electric blue, lime green, hot pink and earthy brown, scattered with deliberate irregularity so no two areas of the shirt repeat. The front is dominated by the oversized illustrated team graphic, making it the clear focal point and anchoring all the surrounding splatter work. The back keeps the same chaotic splatter language, with a large white number outlined in black for legibility against the busy base, and expressive lettering above it. The shorts continue the exact visual system: charcoal patterned base with concentrated multicolour splashes, particularly toward the lower sections, so the full kit reads as one continuous piece rather than a shirt and shorts chosen separately. Overall it is bold, playful and intentionally messy, but controlled through the dark base and consistent tropical graphics, which keep the brightest colours reading as accents rather than taking over the shirt.
